newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Netanyahu joins Israeli-PLO talks, PLO says.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu joins Israeli-PLO talks, PLO says.

text.p: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will join Israeli-Palestinian negotiations on Monday to try to close a deal on a long-delayed pullout from the West Bank town of Hebron, a PLO official said.

"The Palestinian delegation led by (chief PLO negotiatior) Mahmoud Abbas and the Israeli team as well as the Americans will meet with Netanyahu at 2:30 p.m. (1230 GMT)," a senior PLO official said. But Netanyahu's spokesman's office said it had no knowledge of the meeting.
"Both delegations have orders to finalise an accord tonight and if there is agreement, there could be a Netanyahu-Arafat meeting tonight," the official said.
